close_reason: Renamed private validate_session_urls -> validate_session_url_schemes for accuracy. Docstring now explicitly disclaims template-variable validation. Internal change only.
description: src/client.rs:664-680 — `validate_session_urls` iterates [api_url, upload_url, download_url, event_source_url] and checks scheme. Three of those four are RFC 6570 URI templates (containing {accountId}, {blobId}, {types}, etc.), not concrete URLs. Only api_url is a concrete URL. The current scheme check works because url_scheme() does a stringy split on '://' and templates always have the scheme on the left. But the function name implies stronger validation than 'check the prefix'. A template like `{scheme}://example.com/{path}` would have an empty scheme and be (correctly) rejected. Cleaner: rename to `validate_session_url_schemes` so the limited check is on the tin. Or expand the validation: ensure required template variables are present (api_url has none; upload_url must have {accountId}; etc.). Note: locked crate.
title: validate_session_urls treats RFC 6570 URI templates as bare URLs
